invalid: The selected record response was incomplete. Your draft is retained.
limit: This selection is too large to edit together. Open fewer records. Your recovery checkpoint is retained.
title: Loading selected records
description: Loading the saved records needed for this view. Your editor stays unchanged until loading finishes.
committed: Your records were saved. Loading the saved versions to update this editor.
failed: Selected records could not be loaded. Retry to continue from the last completed batch.
cancelled: Loading cancelled. Your editor and recovery checkpoint are retained.
savedCancelled: Your records were saved, but loading them was cancelled. Retry Save to compare your editor with the saved records.
busy: Finish loading the current selection first.
